label: Irisin Signaling Resistance in Myalgic Encephalomyelitis: A Proposed Mechanistic Framework for Post-Exertional Malaise Involving the TSP-1-HSP90α-αvβ5 Axis.
summary: Myalgic Encephalomyelitis (ME) is a chronic, multisystem disease characterized by systemic metabolic dysfunction and post-exertional malaise (PEM). In this study, we investigated the dysregulation of irisin, an exercise-induced myokine, and its potential antagonism by thrombospondin-1 (TSP-1). In a cross-sectional study (92 ME patients vs. 44 sedentary healthy controls), plasma irisin and TSP-1 levels were measured at baseline and after a 90 min mechanical stress challenge applied to induce PEM…
